description: First-time deployment of new firewall policy to production — canary required

playbook.content:
- name: Deploy new firewall policy
  hosts: production
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.template:
        src: iptables.rules.j2
        dest: /etc/iptables/rules.v4
    - ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: iptables-restore /etc/iptables/rules.v4

tier_rationale: First rollout of new firewall policy — canary required
